build_provenance.note: The conda gcc 16.2.0 toolchain requires --sysroot and -B pointing at the conda sysroot lib64 for the C runtime startup objects (Scrt1.o/crti.o) to resolve; the build_env.sh shim records this. The executable SHA differs from the stale pre-built 930f173c... because this is a fresh clean rebuild with the correct sysroot.

acceptance_criteria_verification.evidence_detail: write_compose -> read_compose preserves all 10 per-row mask fields (row_status, yn_present, yp_present, ye_present, ymu_present, abar_present, zbar_present, yh_present, c3_applicable, c4_applicable) through the 27-column internal CSV. Fortran compose_eos_types.f90 eos_data_t lines 34-37 and Python EOSData lines 66-75 hold the corresponding fields.

A row with Ymu_present=True and Ymu=0.0 round-trips: again.Ymu_present[0] is True and again.Ymu[0]==0.0. An explicitly written zero is present; an omitted species is absent (the zero-vs-missing distinction, CompOSE v3.01).

A phase-only row (Npairs=0, Nquad=0) round-trips with exactly 6 fields 'iT inb iYq Iphase 0 0'. The sparse-writer Nquad=0 double-emit bug (the audit's compose_eos_io.f90:734 fix, commit 46c8efa) is verified: the Nquad=0 branch now writes a clean line terminator instead of a stray second '0'.

acceptance_criteria_verification.criterion: reject duplicate IDs and trailing tokens
acceptance_criteria_verification.evidence_test: test_fortran_frontend.py::test_duplicate_composition_density_key_is_rejected (duplicate density key); reader trailing-field check at compose_eos_io.f90:305 (if pos/=nt+1 -> reject)
acceptance_criteria_verification.evidence_detail: Duplicate composition density keys raise NativeExecutionError; the reader rejects trailing fields beyond the parsed Nquad quadruples (the 'reject trailing tokens' guard). Duplicate nuclear-group qid within a row is rejected at compose_eos_io.f90:299.

A row missing Ymu is C3-applicable but C4-not-applicable; a row missing Yn is C4-applicable but C3-not-applicable. C3 (baryon closure Yn+Yp+Yh=1) and C4 (charge closure Yp+(Z/A)Yh=Ye+Ymu) applicability are computed independently per row in the reader (compose_eos_io.f90 lines 330-343), verifier (compose_eos_verify.f90 lines 117-144), and writer (compose_eos_io.f90 lines 655-675). CHECKED/PARTIAL/NOT_AVAILABLE/FAIL remain distinct (test_mixed_coverage_yields_checked_partial_not_available_and_fail).

A GM1 source with mixed coverage (phase-only rows + fully-covered rows + an out-of-range row) reads as PARTIAL + CHECKED + FAIL in one pass, no abort. GM1 outer-crust phase-only rows do not fail from zero-initialized missing data; Iphase is preserved.

acceptance_criteria_verification.criterion: C4 inapplicable where Abar=0 / Z-A undefined
acceptance_criteria_verification.evidence_detail: When the representative nuclear group dissolves (Abar=0, Z/A undefined), C4 is set inapplicable on that row (reconstruct_master compose_eos_reconstruct.f90 lines 979-982: out%c4_applicable(last_crust)=.false., row_status=PARTIAL). The verifier skips C4 when Abar<=0 (compose_eos_verify.f90:135). The writer's C4 closure guard also skips Abar<=0 (compose_eos_io.f90:667). The generated Yh=0 remains in the baryon inventory for C3.

full_suite_status_at_HEAD.interpretation: The 3 default-PATH failures (test_tov_solver_star_integration, test_fortran_and_python_interface_transfers_agree_for_both_conversion_limits, test_vanishing_density_jump_recovers_smooth_fortran_tov_solution) are all in the COWLING track (python_frontend/compose_cowling/solver.py) and all fail with 'gfortran is required for the TOV/Cowling backend' because shutil.which('gfortran') returns None when only the conda triple-name x86_64-conda-linux-gnu-gfortran is available. They are ENVIRONMENT_OR_COMPILER failures (failure taxonomy), NOT EOS-02A or physics failures. With the conda env + sysroot shim on PATH, all 3 pass and the full suite is green (106 passed, 2 skipped, exit 0). The shim records the exact compiler/flags/sysroot needed to reproduce.
